page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 physical cores operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a 2.0 GB per core ratio. This instance does not include local NVMe storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by a Geekbench single-core score of 963.0 and a low single-threaded gzip compression rate of 19.02 GB/sec. However, the 32 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance, with a PassMark CPU score of 23,057.96 and a multi-core stress-ng CPU result of 23,528.93. Memory bandwidth is average, reaching 92.61 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads, though the overall PassMark memory score is positioned in the lower tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge offers a balanced profile for parallelized workloads that can leverage its 32 dedicated cores without requiring high single-thread performance or local SSD storage. It is well-suited for multi-threaded applications such as software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations, as evidenced by its average performance in Clang compilation and Redis SET operations. It can also handle basic medium-sized LLM inference tasks, though it is not optimized for heavy single-threaded execution or memory-intensive databases.
